interactions.description: read HOBO-552 role tutorial outline contract

quickstartFixtureRefs.tutorialUse: role outlines start from the accepted object graph fixture rather than inventing tutorial resources
all role outlines can start from accepted manifest collection output without running a live collector
plan and approval tutorial steps consume the same DeploymentPlan and Gatekeeper preview fixture
deploy-oriented tutorial checkpoints consume the accepted simulated Deployment Set receipt
inspect and doctor tutorial steps read replayed projection evidence instead of plan-only state
blocked and stale tutorial branches use the accepted doctor/stale-evidence fixture
platform, GitOps, and DevOps outlines can reference migration preview evidence without adoption authority
rollback and recovery tutorial branches use accepted snapshot-restore preview evidence
every outline carries an explicit recovery and production-live boundary

coveragePaths.evidence: each role reaches an accepted fixture-backed checkpoint with expected outputs and proof-mode labels
each role names a blocked branch and support-safe next action instead of hiding failed evidence
each role routes stale or unknown evidence through the HOBO-577 doctor fixture and safe limitation wording
each role has a support handoff with owner, evidence source, and safe next step

outlines.personaGoal: Move from a sample app idea to collect, plan, deploy simulation, inspect, and recovery evidence without choosing providers.
prerequisites: accepted snapshop resource lifecycle quickstart fixtures
local repository with mocked HoBo boundaries and no provider credentials
outlines.fixtureStrategy: Reuse HOBO-577 define, collect, plan, deploy, inspect, stale-evidence, and scope-out fixtures so the tutorial proves workflow shape without provider execution.
outlines.failureBranch: If plan evidence is stale or unknown, route to hobo doctor over rlq-manage-stale-evidence-v1 and stop before deploy claims.
accessibilityNotes: Terminal examples preserve command, output, proof mode, and next action in keyboard-copyable text.
Screen reader and non-visual readers get explicit status labels instead of color-only success or failure.
outlines.supportHandoff: Support receives fixture id, failed checkpoint, proof mode, and next safe action without customer payloads or credentials.

outlines.personaGoal: Evaluate provider defaults, resource definitions, and approval boundaries before app teams rely on inferred Camps.
prerequisites: accepted resource definition and plan-preview fixtures
policy owner for inferred Camp approval remains outside this proof
outlines.fixtureStrategy: Bind platform-default tutorial steps to DeploymentPlan, stale-evidence, and migration-preview fixtures while keeping provider catalogs mocked.
expectedOutputs: provider-default checklist tied to fixture ids
Gatekeeper preview for inferred Camp approval
outlines.failureBranch: If a provider default is missing or stale, stop at doctor guidance and route to platform owner before app tutorials advance.
accessibilityNotes: Keyboard order follows prerequisite, command, expected evidence, and owner-route cells.
Screen reader and non-visual summaries include environment, proof mode, and owner route.
outlines.supportHandoff: Route blocked defaults to Platform Engineering with proof fixture, missing decision, and no live provider credentials.

outlines.personaGoal: Turn PR-driven plan, preview, promotion, rollback, and drift evidence into a tutorial outline that stays CLI-first.
prerequisites: CI fixture can render hobo plan and hobo up output as reference transcript
promotion and rollback are simulated against Deployment Set fixtures
outlines.fixtureStrategy: Reuse plan, deploy, migration, snapshot-recovery, and recovery scope-out fixtures so GitOps learns PR automation behavior without mutable production deploys.
expectedOutputs: rollback dry-run limitation and owner route
outlines.failureBranch: If CI reads stale plan evidence, require a fresh hobo plan fixture and route unsupported promotion to release owner.
accessibilityNotes: CI tutorial output includes text status for pending, blocked, stale, and accepted states.
Non-visual readers get the exact command, fixture id, and support owner in each PR-comment example.
outlines.supportHandoff: Support receives PR fixture id, failed command, release owner, and customer-safe limitation wording.

outlines.personaGoal: Review policy, proof evidence, denial, and waiver boundaries for tutorial steps without granting hidden authority.
prerequisites: Gatekeeper and policy-denial fixtures are accepted
no static keys, provider credentials, or customer data appear in examples
outlines.fixtureStrategy: Use accepted Gatekeeper and stale-evidence fixtures to teach safe refusals, proof modes, and support escalation before approval.
outlines.failureBranch: If evidence is missing, tutorial stops at denial and records owner route rather than adding waiver or policy bypass behavior.
accessibilityNotes: Security warnings are text-first and do not rely on color or icon-only denial states.
Screen reader and non-visual summaries include denied capability, proof mode, and required owner.
outlines.supportHandoff: Route policy-denied tutorial states to SecOps owner with redacted evidence and no credentials.

outlines.personaGoal: Outline self-host bootstrap, runner health, import preview, and restore evidence while keeping control-plane implementation out of scope.
prerequisites: seed Yard and runner examples are represented as fixtures only
brownfield migration preview fixture is accepted before any adoption claims
outlines.fixtureStrategy: Frame self-host, import, and restore tutorial steps as reference fixtures so no hosted control-plane or live runner is created.
outlines.failureBranch: If runner or import evidence is stale, the tutorial routes to support/debug ownership before any live bootstrap claim.
accessibilityNotes: Long command transcripts include copyable commands and stable headings for keyboard navigation.
Non-visual readers get plain-language runner state, proof mode, and owner handoff in each expected output.
outlines.supportHandoff: Route bootstrap, runner, or import failures to DevOps/support-debug owner with fixture evidence only.

outlines.personaGoal: Teach incident inspection, logs, stale projections, rollback preview, and support-safe escalation from replayable evidence.
prerequisites: incident and projection examples are reference fixtures
rollback remains a dry-run or scope-out boundary until release gates exist
outlines.fixtureStrategy: Pin SRE tutorial steps to stale projection and recovery scope-out fixtures so the outline proves diagnosis workflow, not live remediation.
outlines.failureBranch: If the incident cannot be classified from fixtures, escalate to human owner and do not claim autonomous remediation.
accessibilityNotes: Timeline output is ordered text with timestamps, status labels, and keyboard-copyable evidence ids.
Screen reader and non-visual summaries include severity, proof mode, and next owner rather than color-only status.
outlines.supportHandoff: Route unclassified or stale incident tutorial states to SRE/support owner with redacted logs and fixture ids.
